title_as_printed: Isopiestic Molalities m and Osmotic Coefficients phi of MgSO4(aq) and m* and phi* of the KCl(aq) and NaCl(aq) Isopiestic Reference Standard Solutions at 298.15 K, and the Equilibration Times t

footnotes_as_printed.a: Osmotic coefficients for the reference standard solutions of KCl(aq) and NaCl(aq) were calculated from the equations given by Archer (1992a, 1997).
footnotes_as_printed.b: A fanlike device was added to the chamber after it was opened for this experiment; it provided some stirring of the vapor phase as the chamber was rocked back-and-forth during the equilibrations, which aided in the transport of water between the different sample cups.
footnotes_as_printed.c: Saturated solution of MgSO4(aq) equilibrated with a reservoir solution containing excess MgSO4.7H2O(cr).

property_note: value = MgSO4 molality, value2 = reference-salt molality m*; reference salt KCl for Series 1 rows, NaCl for Series 2 rows (set by group_rows)
reference_salt: from block label (KCl for Series 1, NaCl for Series 2)
pressure_note: not stated (isopiestic equilibrium at the solution vapour pressure; chambers evacuated of air, for the two Series 2 experiments air removal was less complete)

value.what: MgSO4 isopiestic molality (mean of duplicate samples)

uncertainty.what: printed +/- after m(MgSO4): agreement between duplicate samples, excludes ~0.03 % stock-solution analysis uncertainty

value2.what: reference-salt (KCl or NaCl) isopiestic molality m* (measured)

phi.what: phi = m* phi* / m (eq 2, nu = nu* = 2), molality-based practical osmotic coefficient

phi_ref.what: reference-salt osmotic coefficient from Archer (1992a, 1997) equations (footnote a)

composition.other_species: KCl(aq) (Series 1) or NaCl(aq) (Series 2) reference solution in the partner cups

skip_rows.reason: series label rows (also carried by group_rows)

notes: Each printed cell 'x +/- u' split into a value column and an uncertainty column. Footnote b is glued to the uncertainty of row 2 and footnote c to the uncertainty of row 9 (saturated MgSO4 solution in equilibrium with MgSO4.7H2O(cr); the row 10 MgSO4 molality 3.4850 is supersaturated per the text). Row 9 doubles as the epsomite solubility determination (3.0185 +/- 0.0007 mol/kg). Temperature (298.15 +/- 0.005) K, IPTS-68, from the experimental section.
